# Synthetic EMF fixture

Original test art: a white120×80 frame, red rectangle at10,10 with size40×60, blue rectangle at70,10 with size40×60. Generated2026-10-18 using Windows .NET Framework System.Drawing.Imaging.Metafile with EmfType.EmfOnly and MetafileFrameUnit.Pixel. The drawing context uses a temporary Bitmap; no desktop capture or vendor asset is involved.

This fixture tests Windows platform rasterization, published browser pixels and preservation of original native media during `.story` saves.
